REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION
TUESDAY - AUGUST 27, 2019 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Staff reports are available for public inspection at the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center, 18135 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA
90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1203. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to
the Property Preservation Commission after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the
time each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the
meeting will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five
minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of
appropriate responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence
for the record.

Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-68

A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 19510 Rainbow Court, Cerritos, California, 90703, has overgrown vegetation, weeds, a lack of landscape maintenance, and structure exteriors in need of repair and paint which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7056-002-014).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-69
C.
An appeal of an administrative determination by the Parks Superintendent denying a request to remove one parkway tree adjacent to the property located at 11953 Shasta Circle, Cerritos California, 90703 (APN 7033-006-015).

Property Preservation Commission Case No. TR 2019-02

An appeal of an administrative determination by the Parks Superintendent denying a request to remove one parkway tree adjacent to the property located at 13558 Felson Street, Cerritos California, 90703 (APN 7023-002-055).
